credits.title: ¿Quién hace la...? - 1979
credits.overview: At the end of the 70s, Eduardo Kabral continues with his TV show presenting all the members of his crew.
roles: Eduardo Kabral/Ian Kabral/El Llanero Discreto II

credits.title: ASTRONAUTALIEN
credits.overview: A stranded astronaut orbiting Earth meets an alien who suddenly shows up in his space station.

credits.title: Lola y sus Heraldos
credits.overview: Agustín is a priest on a mission to sabotage the concert of the so-called "satanic" band, Lola and Her Heralds. The mission becomes complicated when he discovers the band may be satanic beyond their music.

credits.title: Sosias
credits.overview: As Dani struggles with a recent romantic rupture, shape-shifting creatures arrive to the town.

credits.title: ¿Quién hace la...?
credits.overview: Eduardo Kabral presents the different members who work in his TV production company and make the magic come to life.

credits.title: Crónicas Paranormales - El especial de Navidad
credits.overview: “Documentary” that shows Christmas 2009, where the Grajales family, a family of hunters, will have to come together to save (as much as possible) their Christmas.

credits.title: Pachamamó
credits.overview: A group of five girls have a try with a psychoactive plant for a ritual.

credits.title: Un Nuevo Amanecer
credits.overview: A psychiatrist interviews her patient, a man with multiple personality disorder, who hides a secret that involves her.

credits.title: Las Aventuras de Pulpo Cromado y Champi - Parte 1
credits.overview: Former 1960s hero, el Langostino de Plata, gives his disciples, Pulpo Cromado and Champi, a new mission to recover a highly dangerous object.

credits.title: Las Aventuras de Pulpo Cromado y Champi - Parte 2
credits.overview: Pulpo Cromado and Champi join the Soviet scientist, Dr. Pitus Erecktonsky to obtain the Mastodon Serum, a powerful drug that gives super-human abilities. However, they won't be the only ones trying to obtain this powerful drug.

credits.title: Crónicas Paranormales - El portal
credits.overview: Paranormal hunting duo Cesar and Edgar, father and son, team up in an unorthodox way to banish a trans-dimensional ghost.

credits.title: Crónicas Paranormales - La llamada
credits.overview: In 1983, César de Grajales, announces in a TV commercial his new invention: A telephone to talk to beings from beyond. During the demonstration of his invention, César makes contact with former president Plutarco Elías Calles.

credits.title: Bitácora del Cazador Paranormal Experto
credits.overview: After the death of their father, Edgar and Erica inherit the family business of hunting paranormal creatures. Carlos calls them because a warlock has been haunting their house.

credits.title: Finding the End of the World
credits.overview: Jorge is a musician, he gets fired trying to find a melody from the noise of the street, the same day his wife and youngest son died. He must appear sane to take care of his oldest son Lucas, otherwise, he will also lose him.
